scenarios.title: Fixture and evidence-contract checks
scenarios.expected: The seed contract, scenario catalogue, local-only reset guard, and evidence validator pass without a network call.

scenarios.title: Invitation, password, MFA, local role, and session
scenarios.expected: An invited synthetic account completes the managed password and MFA flow; its approved local role is intersected with its provider group and the session is restored.

scenarios.title: Allowed event duty and denied cross-event access
scenarios.expected: A synthetic registration/reviewer account works only in its assigned active event and duty; the same account receives a denied response for a second event.

scenarios.title: Suspended, revoked-session, and deprovisioned access
scenarios.expected: After each lifecycle action, the prior browser session is rejected and the account cannot regain event access.

scenarios.title: Registration through consent, QR, and check-in
scenarios.expected: Synthetic Charlie is registered with consent, a QR pass is issued, and check-in changes the expected registration and queue counts.

scenarios.title: Queues, transfers, visual acuity, refraction, and colour vision
scenarios.expected: The synthetic fixture moves through each implemented station, retains its registration, and presents the review queue.

scenarios.title: Eye health as the fourth station
scenarios.expected: Do not mark passed: the Station Library deliberately keeps EYE_HEALTH catalog-only and there is no eye-health capture route/page.

scenarios.title: Clinical review and referral
scenarios.expected: A reviewer with an active event duty records a synthetic decision, creates a referral, and captures only masked recipient evidence.

scenarios.title: Offline save and reconnect
scenarios.expected: A downloaded assigned station saves a synthetic result offline, reconnects, and records exactly one applied sync action.

scenarios.title: Dashboard and export
scenarios.expected: Dashboard counts match sanitized row counts and an authorized event export/report completes without exposing participant details.

blockers: Managed invitation, password, MFA, provider-group intersection, and lifecycle revocation require an approved live deployment and Cognito test accounts.
Station Library maps EYE_HEALTH as non-importable and the dashboard has no eye-health capture page, so the required fourth-station browser path is not implemented.
Offline browser proof depends on an active assigned station, persistent browser storage, and a deliberate connection interruption; unit coverage is not a live reconnect result.
